The three current layout families, their owners, consumers, and exact class taxonomy.

Layout ownership

LayoutOwnerConsumersSource
Application shellDieterRoma ordinary domains; DevStudiodieter/layouts/main-container/
Builder editorBobBob, hosted by the Roma Builder domainbob/components/BuilderApp.tsx + bob/app/bob_app.css
Public WidgetWidget softwareSaved public packages; Bob previewtokyo/product/widgets/*/widget.html + shared Widget runtime

Application shell — Roma and DevStudio

Dieter owns the shared classes and presentation. Each consumer owns navigation content, page content, actions, and compact-navigation open state. Bob does not use this layout internally.

.main-container
├── .left-nav
└── .page
    ├── [data-navigation-scrim]  compact only
    ├── .page__header
    │   └── .page__actions
    └── .page__content
BehaviorContract
FullPersistent navigation at var(--layout-left-nav-width); Page receives remaining space.
CompactThe same navigation overlays the Page at min(var(--layout-compact-left-nav-width), calc(100vw - var(--space-4))); consumer controls data-navigation-open.
Capability boundary(max-width: 599px), (max-height: 599px)
Page contentHeader and content share 80rem maximum width.

Editable application-layout tokens

TokenSource valueAction
--layout-left-nav-width 12rem
--layout-left-nav-padding var(--space-4)
--layout-page-padding var(--space-4)
--layout-compact-left-nav-width 12rem

Builder editor — Bob

Roma gives its Builder Page body to Bob. Bob owns the editor composition and keeps the same session when its ToolDrawer becomes a Compact overlay.

.builder-app
├── .topdrawer
└── .editor-content
    ├── .tooldrawer
    │   ├── .tdheader
    │   └── .tdcontent
    ├── .tooldrawer-scrim          compact only
    └── .workspace
        ├── .workspace-iframe
        ├── .workspace-status-overlay  conditional
        └── .workspace-overlay

Full: persistent .tooldrawer beside .workspace. Compact: the same ToolDrawer overlays the full Workspace. .topdrawer remains Bob editor chrome, not a Roma Page header.

Public Widget — Stage, Pod, Shell, Header, Core

Widget software owns this runtime composition. Shared implementation does not make presentation or delivery chrome a Shell child.

.stage[data-role="stage"]
└── .pod[data-role="pod"]
    └── .ck-headerLayout[data-ck-widget][data-ck-instance-id]  Shell
        ├── .ck-header                                      Header
        └── .ck-headerLayout__body                          Core
PartOwns
StageOuter canvas, placement, alignment, padding, background, floating behavior, and resize reporting.
PodInner content surface, width, padding, background, border, radius, and shadow.
ShellExactly Header + Core; also carries Widget type and materialized instance identity.
HeaderTitle, subtitle, optional Header CTA, and Header layout.
CoreWidget-specific body, behavior, content, and Core geometry.

Branding, locale selection, and social sharing attach as Widget chrome around Stage or Pod. They are not children of Shell, Header, or Core.
